title: Reliable Cloud Load Status
notes: Clears the temporary Syncing state after a cloud revision is successfully loaded onto the device.
Makes the workspace indicator immediately recalculate as Cloud synced after the loaded snapshot and sync fingerprint are saved.
Fixes the status-only issue observed on iPad and Samsung after using Load cloud.
Does not change cloud writes, Firebase rules, document formats, calculations, or permissions.
Preserves the m40.8.2 workspace header fix and removal of legacy Finish and Send to Blaster controls.
